visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a white turtleneck smiles and talks directly into a handheld camera in a selfie-style close-up. (2) He is then seen from behind carrying the large top section of an artificial green tree up a staircase with white tile and wooden railings. In the living room, he lifts this large foliage piece onto a metal pole stand next to a couch. (3) The man then stands inside the foliage of a large, silver-grey artificial Christmas tree decorated with red ribbons and balls. POV shots show him peering out from the dense green interior of the tree's top part, grinning at the camera. (4) An elderly woman in a brown long-sleeved shirt and a white scarf enters the living room. She walks up to the silver Christmas tree and begins adjusting the decorations, touching the red ribbons while talking. (5) Suddenly, the tree jolts and the man inside shouts. The woman jumps back in terror, running several steps away toward the stairs with her hands raised. The man is shown laughing hysterically from inside the needles. In the background, two elderly men are seen sitting on chairs, watching the scene unfold in a traditional indoor living room setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks excitedly with high pitch variability, explaining a prank over an upbeat, synthetic comedic BGM with a steady electronic beat. (2) The sound of rustling plastic and light footsteps occurs as the man moves the tree parts. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) A middle-aged female voice enters, speaking in a calm, melodic narrative tone with moderate volume. She reminisces while touching the tree. (4) A sudden, high-arousal female scream and the sound of rapid shuffling footsteps punctuate the mix as the tree 'shouts'. (5) Loud, boisterous laughter from the male follows, overlapping with the woman's surprised and breathless speech. The BGM swells slightly before fading during a final male narration segment.
